scenicChapters.title: Cevennes Corniche
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 31 km. 1026 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Cevennes Corniche
scenicChapters.narrative: This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else. 47 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Cevennes Corniche
scenicChapters.narrative: For 22 km this is Cevennes Corniche, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

cevennes-corniche.story: A one-way ride of 100 km, Florac to Anduze - roughly 1 h 21 in the saddle. It goes by way of Col des Faisses and Saint Jean du Gard. The highest point is about 1,050 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
